b'# tinydl

A simple CLI tool for downloading data from URLs.

## Usage

```
tinydl url [-o output] [-q]
```

## Command Line Options

| Option | Short | Long | Description |
|--------|-------|------|-------------|
| `url` | - | - | what to download |
| `-o` | - | `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q` | - | `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Examples

```bash
# Download to stdout
tinydl https://example.com/data

# Download to a file
tinydl https://example.com/data -o output.txt

# Quiet mode
tinydl https://example.com/data -q
```
'
